body:

Deliverable complete; foldable design note at `.agent/reports/g2-misconception-mint-rule-design-2026-06-10.md` (the claimed path; review-folded; yours to fold into the plan's g2 todo and commit).

VERDICT: mint `misconception:<lessonSlug>#<hash16(normalise(text))>` — content-hash, lesson-scoped, text-only. Ordinal rejected; hybrid rejected; unit-scope rejected (all recorded with grounds in the note).

THE FOUR BRIEFED QUESTIONS, ANSWERED:
1. Duplication: zero within-lesson duplicate texts across 12,391 slugs (zero hash collisions for either hash input); 473 multi-placement slugs carry byte-identical pairs that hash dedups by construction and ordinal would mint as duplicate-content node pairs; 665 cross-lesson shared texts, 37% with differing (normalised) responses — which justifies lesson-scope + text-only hash.
2. Ordinal stability: 100% stable across the observed window — but the window is vacuous as future evidence (the bulk EXPORT is static and lags live: english-ks4 keywords byte-stable with 05-21 at 1,511 normalised vs live 2,090). The case against ordinal is structural: silent re-pointing, renumber cascade, and enumeration sensitivity (discoverBulkFiles is unsorted readdir — re-traced in source by the assumptions reviewer). A faithful re-mine of the fresh bulk reproduces the committed 2026-03-07 dataset 100.000% exactly — pipeline determinism proven.
3. G1a contract honoured: kind-qualified template-literal id, materialised `id` field, id-sorted deterministic emission, droppedDuplicates provenance (G1a droppedEdges-class, fail-loud).
4. Contract-test shape: five parts — order-independence, churn semantics (incl. the review-added slug-rename case 2d), dedup idempotence + provenance with the real-corpus 473-count guard, golden vectors (pinned normalisation + hash; NFC assertion not transform), edge-end integrity.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (both grounded first-hand against the worktree; full dispositions in the note §Adversarial review): architecture-expert-betty = CONCERNS, no blocker, core recommendation confirmed sound — both concerns (slug-rename cascade acknowledgment + missing contract case) FOLDED; her "silent-cascade via different path" framing refuted with grounds (slug churn is honest churn, and the qualifier is in BOTH candidate mints, so not a discriminator). assumptions-expert = SOUND — reproduced every quantitative claim exactly; three labelling corrections folded (normalised vs raw figures; 12,391/12,385 reconciliation; empty-array vs blank-text precision).

OPEN ITEMS NAMED NOT DECIDED (note §Open items): hash prefix length (16 hex recommended, one-line constant); droppedDuplicates surfacing shape (provenance array recommended); the standing bulk-export-lags-live owner item — with the new datum that the 2026-06-10 export still serves 2026-05-21-identical content on the measured axes (the lag is upstream, not our download timing).

GATE FLAG for the coordination home (not mine to fix, surfacing per all-gates-blocking): `pnpm markdownlint-check:root` is currently RED on three pre-existing errors outside my boundary — napkin.md:227-228 (MD032/MD022, in the 19:0xZ owner-directed capture window) and 2026-06-10-celestial-orbit-seat-b-g1b-c2-to-eclipsed.md:35 (MD004 plus-style list). My report file is clean (0 over-100 lines, 0 lint errors). These will block your next continuity commit's gate.

CLAIM: closing 5a3b5b87-8f6a-477b-a931-abc94f5cf2ee at this delivery (natural boundary; read-only analysis complete; no source edits made — the note is the only artefact, at its claimed path).
